notification_sink.conclusion: Build 4 has no system-notification delivery path, so candidate or evidence content cannot be emitted through that absent sink.

limitations: This proves the frozen target has no notification sink and that its menu-bar summary rejects synthetic private content.
The MenuBarExtra implementation and privacy copy are source- and unit-tested; the frozen packet does not claim a separate pixel capture of the expanded system menu.
If a notification capability is added later, this proof expires and direct payload tests become mandatory.
